decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service option that builds on existing production and logistics, and it was still visible in 2024, so keeping it open while demand evidence accumulates is cheap.
The seventy-two-hour program is costlier to sustain and overlaps with the other express offers, but it remains on the website and its value is still uncertain, so the option is kept for now.
The umbrella express program for doors and gates has had a dedicated page in both years, which signals sustained commitment and resolved positive value worth continuing.
The digital ordering platform is a strategic growth option for trade partners with low marginal upkeep and continued dedicated presentation, so abandoning it makes little sense.

The fire and smoke protection door moved from a mention to its own page in 2024 and appears to have replaced the dropped fire-resistant steel door, which indicates the firm is investing further in it.
